claude-s · promo-video

Plexus launch promo

18 s launch promo for Plexus, my free NEET PG / INI-CET prep site, from its repo (~/PersonalFiles/neetpg, apps/www). Real mark, colours, fonts, copy, UI and numbers only. One idea: the exam's own questions, mapped. Build every shot from the mark's one primitive (a hub, a spoke, a node). Banned: glass cards, gradients, orange as a field, bouncy type, crossfades, holds over 0.6 s, invented numbers, click sounds, a stinger.

What the skill did

  • Brand from the repo: the hub-and-five-spokes mark from logo.tsx, #fe551b as the only accent, General Sans and Aeonik from app/fonts, the landing copy ("Everything the exam has asked. Mapped."), and every number checked against the data: 3,631 recall questions, 19 papers, 73 keys corrected, 220 cross-checked.
  • One primitive throughout: a dot field blooms into the hub, the five spokes draw out, and the same hub-spoke-node becomes the 19-spoke /roadmap map, the list bullets, one dot per recall question, and the logo.
  • Screen as portal: an eased dive into the mark's hub lands on the map's hub at the same size; the 19 spokes grow out of it on ink, and the white page opens from the hub as the chrome loads.
  • The real UI redrawn from its components inside one player frame that moves instead of cutting: the radial map sized by recall weightage, skeleton flash on the chrome and Index, a hover that dims the other subjects, the Index jumping to ENT, the topic sheet with its question skeletons, and a real NEET PG 2025 question answered.
  • Then a slot-list roll of the real places with their real counts, a proof board that draws all 3,631 questions in exam order (cross-checked bright, corrected keys orange), and a shutter that closes the board into the Open the map button.
  • Built the skill's way: brief with a banned list, beat grid at 120 BPM, a stills gate before every render, 16 subframes of motion blur (32 to 48 on the dive, the pushes, the shrink and the iris, rendered as segments and spliced in), and two critique rounds, each with a contact sheet, a labelled spectrogram and a fresh critic subagent, then a final measured check.

Sound

  • An arp bed with the whole mix low-passed at 1.8 kHz under a dark build (a sub swell and a sine glide) that stops when the picture freezes; the filter opens in 20 ms as "Mapped." lands with the groove.
  • 120 BPM groove with a long syncopated kick (300 to 55 Hz on beats 0, 1.5 and 2.5); every cut lands on a kick, and the bass drops out for the beat before each new idea so the kick on the cut is the re-entry.
  • Foley for objects (spokes, the sheet, the rolling list, the landing dots, the counters, the button) and silence for all four clicks.
  • The pressed button is pulled into the hub, then half a second of silence before the logo, then an eight-repeat echo tail instead of a stinger, each repeat sending a ring of dots out from the hub.
